Name: Animated Medieval Well
Author: Sugao
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings[/url]﻿ contains a lovely little [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4642]spring-style well[/url] (especially nice with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6196]Animals Need Water[/url], as it lets your animals drink from wells and I doubt cow hooves are very handy with a bucket and crank), but it's static despite having a waterfall. So, I took the sprites and animated them. Water flows, plants ripple in a breeze, leaves bob on the surface, and the winter ice sparkles and drips (yes, it's seasonal just like the original). I only did the toned colors, with the greener rocks in autumn, because that's the file set I personally prefer and this was enough of a hassle that I don't care to repeat it. The animation isn't [i]perfect[/i] (my pixel animation skills leave much to be desired), but I think it's serviceable.

All credit for the original Medieval Buildings belongs to Eemiestardew, with the Content Patcher version and well by Gweniaczek.
